provenance.meaning: Actual final staging evidence after the narrow supporting-copy fix. Staging acceptance is distinct from a production release or production AFTER verification.

method: Native network responses and original screenshot bytes. No route fulfillment, storage seeding, account creation, login, auth submission, email or member-data mutation. GET/HEAD/OPTIONS only; other methods were blocked before dispatch. Library cards scrolled into view before 24 thumbnail decodes; loaded fonts, background photos, focus, auth transitions, document and auth-panel containment checked.

safety.temporaryStagingBoundary: Exact staging origin only; foreign requests and cross-origin redirects blocked. No access material is included.
